node.clearTitle: Clear every node from the canvas (can be undone)
node.layersTitle: Open the layer list and drag layers or folders onto groups
node.addTitle: Add a node: group, exclusion, dependency, note, or preview
node.importTitle: Import a .json config (groups, rules, node positions…)
node.exportTitle: Save the current setup as a .json config for another PSD
node.multiTitle: Select multiple: click to toggle, then drag any selected item
node.drawerHint: Drop on a group to add one option (a folder is one variant); drop on empty space to create a group. Ctrl-click selects multiple items; Shift-click selects a range. On phones, turn on Multi-select, tap items, then drag one to move them together.
node.helpLines: Open the layer list with Layers. Drop a layer or folder on a group to add one option; drop it on empty space to create a group.
Select a row in a group to preview it in the small preview. Delete options or groups, and click a group name to rename it.
Connect a group's right port to Combinations × to include it. The Combinations node explains each factor.
Drag a port from an option or group to another option or group to add an exclusion or dependency. Exclusion allows at most one; dependency means A requires B.
The top-left controls undo / redo, clear the canvas, add nodes, apply examples, and import or export JSON configs.
A layer bundle shows several layers together as one option. Drop layers into it, then connect its right port to a group's left port.
For multi-select in the layer list, Ctrl-click or Shift-click on desktop, or enable Multi-select on phones. Drag any selected item to move them together.
To disconnect a wire, click it and choose Disconnect, or drag its endpoint to empty space.
Drag a node by its title. Drag empty canvas to pan; use the wheel or pinch to zoom.
node.previewTitle: Current selection preview (click to enlarge / shrink)
